object.attr: as implemented: since 0.3.0 a commit that changed only the figure is listed, because a figure change makes links suspect too. Commits on other branches aren't listed. Replaced by MELLON-VER-SRS-218, which says how merge commits count (Q-V15).
object.description: The History tab shall list, newest first, the commits on the latest commit's history that changed the selected object's file or figure, and no other commit.
